transactions.desc: The Nationals recalled Varland from Triple-A Rochester on Tuesday, Grant Paulsen of 106.7 The Fan reports.
The Reds recalled Franco from Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday, Charlie Goldsmith of Fox 19 Now Cincinnati reports.
Hernandez was sent outright to Triple-A Gwinnett on Monday.

The Nationals optioned Alvarez to Triple-A Rochester following Monday's 3-2 loss to Toronto. He allowed one earned run on four hits and three walks while striking out three across 4.1 innings in bulk relief.
The Baltimore Orioles traded OF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates.
The Pirates designated Ross for assignment Monday.
The Tigers recalled Valencia from Triple-A Toledo on Monday.
The Cubs selected Wantz's contract from Triple-A Iowa on Monday.
The Cubs designated Taillon for assignment Monday.
The Blue Jays reinstated Scherzer (back/thumb) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Monday in Washington.
The Pirates optioned Ross to Triple-A Indianapolis on Monday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Pirates reinstated Rodriguez (glute) from the 10-day injured list Monday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Nationals recalled Schultz from Triple-A Rochester on Monday.
The Orioles designated Huff for assignment Monday.
The Nationals designated Krook for assignment Monday.
The Orioles recalled Pozo from Double-A Chesapeake on Monday.
The Reds recalled Johnson from Triple-A Louisville on Monday.
The White Sox reinstated Pereira (concussion) from the 7-day injured list Monday.
Atlanta optioned Hicklen to Triple-A Gwinnett on Monday.
Atlanta activated Acuna (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list Monday.
The Brewers released McCullers on Sunday.
The White Sox optioned Perez to Triple-A Charlotte on Monday.
The Athletics designated Hartlieb for assignment Sunday, Jason Burke of Roundtable.io reports.
The Athletics acquired Blewett from the Cardinals on Sunday in exchange for cash considerations Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.
The Chicago White Sox traded RHP Felix Doroteo to the Pittsburgh Pirates.
The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox.
The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the  Athletics.
Kelenic was released by the Rangers on Sunday, Jeff Wilson of AllDLLS.com reports.
The Mets promoted Santucci from Double-A Binghamton to Triple-A Syracuse on Sunday, 2TheBigs.com reports.
Atlanta will promote Southisene from High-A Rome to Double-A Columbus on Monday, Geoff Pontes of Baseball America reports.
